hero.title: Every PDF tool in one place, files never leave your device
hero.subtitle: Merge, split, compress, convert, and sign PDFs right in your browser. Processed 100% on your device. No account, no limits, free.

trust.local_desc: Everything runs in your browser. Your files go nowhere.
trust.offline_desc: Load the page once, then keep using it even when you are offline.
trust.free_desc: All 12 tools, no account, no locked features.

merge.title: Merge PDF
merge.error: Could not read {{name}}. The remaining files still work.
merge.dropzone_hint: or click to browse. Each file under 200 MB.
merge.thumb_hint: click to deselect, drag to reorder

sign.title: Sign document
sign.preview_hint: Click the signing spot on the preview
sign.preview_resize: Drag a corner to resize. Multiple spots and pages supported.
sign.disclaimer: Image signatures suit internal approval. Self-signed digital signing (PKCS#7) uses a certificate created on your own device — Adobe/UPDF will flag it "untrusted"; it is not equivalent to a CA-issued signature. Certified USB-token signing ships in a later release.
sign.position_picked_hint: the spot you picked on the preview
sign.dropzone_hint: or click to browse · one file under 200 MB
sign.type_placeholder: Type your name to create a signature
sign.upload_hint: PNG images only, each under 200 MB
sign.single_note: Self-signed digital signing supports one signature per file; signing the same file twice is not supported.
sign.scope_note: No CA-issued or USB-token certificates in this release.
sign.progress_idle: Draw, type, or upload a signature, pick spots, then place it.
sign.err_no_signature: Draw, type, or upload a signature first.
sign.err_no_spot: Click the page preview to pick a signing spot.
sign.err_heic: HEIC/HEIF files are not accepted. Export to JPG/PNG first.
sign.err_not_png: File {{name}} is not a PNG image. PNG only.
sign.digital_hint: Generates a key pair and self-signed certificate on your device; nothing is uploaded. Adobe/UPDF show "untrusted" because it is not CA-issued.
sign.err_already_signed: This file already has a digital signature; only one signature per file is supported in this release.
sign.digital_ack: I understand this certificate is created on this device — Adobe/UPDF will flag it "untrusted".
sign.err_ack_missing: Acknowledge the self-signed certificate scope before signing.
sign.cert_hint: Use your existing digital certificate. The private key never leaves this device.
sign.cert_warn_expired: The certificate HAS EXPIRED — readers will flag the signature.
sign.cert_warn_not_yet: The certificate is not valid yet (from {{date}}).
sign.cert_warn_chain: No intermediate in the bundle — readers may be unable to build the trust chain.
sign.cert_ack: I understand this signature uses my real certificate; readers show it as trusted only when the CA chain is installed on their machine.
sign.cert_bad_password: Wrong certificate password. Re-enter and try again.
sign.cert_invalid: This file is not a valid .p12/.pfx certificate.

split.title: Split PDF
split.dropzone_hint: or click to browse · a single file under 200 MB
split.thumb_hint: click a thumbnail to add/remove a page
split.mode_separate_hint: Each range becomes its own file.
split.mode_combined_hint: Merge every selected range into a single file.
split.err_unreadable: Could not read this file. Try a different one.
split.err_bad: "{{part}}" is not valid. Use page numbers, for example: 1-3,5.
split.err_overlap: Page {{page}} appears in more than one range.

extract.title: Extract pages
extract.dropzone_hint: or click to browse · one file under 200 MB
extract.error_load: Could not read this file. Try another PDF.
extract.error_no_selection: No pages selected. Pick at least one page.
extract.error_save: Could not extract pages. Try again.

compress.title: Compress PDF
compress.dropzone_hint: or click to browse · one file under 200 MB
compress.mode_vector_hint: Repacks objects with qpdf; text stays vector and selectable.
compress.mode_image_hint: Renders each page to a lighter JPEG. Text selection is lost.
compress.raster_warning: The image-compressed file is page snapshots — text can no longer be selected or copied. Only use it when you need a light file to send or view.
compress.quality_small_hint: Lightest file, images may look softer.
compress.size_recommend: Recommended: keep files ≤ 100 MB for faster, more reliable compression.
compress.result_ok_vector: Vector pack saved {{pct}}% with text intact.
compress.result_low_vector: Vector pack saved only {{pct}}% — this file is probably already packed.
compress.result_ok_image: Image recompress saved {{pct}}%; remember text is no longer selectable.
compress.result_larger: The compressed file is larger (up {{pct}}%). Keep the original.
compress.result_low_image: Image recompress saved only {{pct}}% — keep the original if text looks blurry.
compress.error_load: Could not read this file. Try another PDF.
compress.err_heic: HEIC/HEIF files are not accepted. Export to JPG/PNG first.
compress.err_encode: Could not recompress images. Try again.
compress.mode_linearize_hint: Restructures the file so the first page renders quickly when opened online. No compression.
compress.result_ok_linearize: Web-optimized — the first page now renders fast when streamed.
compress.modes_hint: Vector pack keeps text intact — best for text-heavy files. Image recompress suits scans and photo-heavy files. Web-optimizer does not compress — it just makes the first page render fast when streamed.

pdf-to-img.dropzone_hint: or click to browse · one file under 200 MB

pdf-to-img.progress_idle: Pick a format and DPI, then export.
pdf-to-img.error_load: Could not read this file. Try another PDF.
pdf-to-img.error_save: Could not render pages. Try again.
pdf-to-img.zip_hint: multi-page: all images are packed into one .zip
pdf-to-img.zip_overflow: Images exceed 200 MB in total — switched to per-image downloads.

img-to-pdf.err_not_image: File {{name}} is not a JPG or PNG image.

encrypt.title: Encrypt PDF
encrypt.dropzone_hint: or click to browse · one file under 200 MB
encrypt.warn_forgot: A forgotten password cannot be recovered — an encrypted file cannot be reopened without it. Write the password down before continuing.
encrypt.owner_pass_placeholder: Blank = same as the open password
encrypt.owner_pass_hint: The owner password controls print/copy permissions. Leave blank to reuse the open password.
encrypt.bits_256_hint: AES-256 encryption; opens in Adobe/UPDF with the right password.
encrypt.bits_128_hint: 128-bit AES fallback (--use-aes=y), not weak RC4. Only for old devices that cannot open AES-256.
encrypt.bits_note: AES-256 is the default. The 128-bit mode always uses AES (--use-aes=y), never RC4.
encrypt.size_recommend: Recommended: keep files ≤ 100 MB for faster, more reliable encryption.
encrypt.progress_idle: Pick a file, enter the password, then run.
encrypt.err_wrong_password: Wrong password. Check it and try again.
encrypt.err_timeout: Processing took too long (over 60 seconds) and was stopped. Try again with a smaller file.
encrypt.err_heic: HEIC/HEIF files are not accepted. Export to JPG/PNG first.
